description: The main window. The live site (a remote origin) may invoke the stream pop-out command, read/set launch-on-startup, set the taskbar badge, set the display mode (fullscreen / borderless / windowed), post a native notification, and open an http(s) link in the real browser; pop-out windows themselves get no IPC. NB `allow-open-external` is OUR command, whose Rust side refuses every scheme but http and https — the opener plugin's own open_url permission is deliberately NOT granted, because that one would take any scheme the OS has a handler for.
